model.normalisation: percentile rank across all tracts in the county
model.outdoor_metric: jobs per km² (tract area from polygon geometry)

component_sources.svi: CDC/ATSDR SVI 2022, RPL_THEMES overall percentile ranking
component_sources.elderly: CDC/ATSDR SVI 2022, E_AGE65 / E_TOTPOP, percentile-ranked in county
component_sources.outdoor_workers: LEHD LODES8 WAC 2021, jobs in NAICS 11/21/22/23/48-49 per km², percentile-ranked in county

model.caveat: Weights are a stated modelling prior, not fitted to heat-outcome data. They are configurable and reported with every result.
